synopsis: My vision and mind were consumed by N. The disappearance of five junior high school boys. The brutal murder of an entire Elementary School class. A car crash leaving two dead. The letter "N" was left at the scene of each of these crimes. A popular urban legend has it that the main culprit is a religious group named "N," which was supposed to have collapsed 2,000 years ago. What on earth is "N"? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: In Another World With My Smartphone
titleRomaji: Isekai wa Smartphone to Tomo ni.
titleEnglish: In Another World With My Smartphone
titleNative: 異世界はスマートフォンとともに。
synopsis: After a freak accident involving some lightning winds up zapping him dead, 15-year-old Mochizuki Touya wakes up to find himself face-to-face with God. “I am afraid to say that I have made a bit of a blunder...” laments the old coot. But all is not lost! God says that he can reincarnate Touya into a world of fantasy, and as a bonus, he gets to bring his smartphone along with! So begins Touya's adventure in a new, anachronistic pseudo-medieval world. Friends! Laughs! Tears! Inexplicable Deus ex Machina! He sets off on a journey full of wonder as he absentmindedly travels from place to place, following whatever goal catches his fancy. The curtains lift on an epic tale of swords, sorcery, and smartphone apps! (Source: J-Novel Club)

synopsis: Tachibana Hinata and Jinguji Tsukasa are two young men who have been friends since childhood. After a disaster of a singles mixer, they’re sent flying into another world by a mysterious being–and now Tachibana is a beautiful blonde girl! When Jinguji angrily demands that they be returned home and go back to normal, they get cursed, and the only way out is for them to go on a quest and defeat the demon king. But…now the two friends can’t stop thinking about how hot the other is. Will they save the world before their lifelong bromance becomes a romance? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Ranked 19th place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

synopsis: Gaku is the son of former Japanese national volleyball star Kei Shishiya. Through middle school, he's played as his team's ace hitter, though part of him wonders if that's a title he earned, or one he was simply given. One day, Kei meets Noboru, a generational volleyball talent with a monstrous spiking arm, and vows to turn him into the next national standout. In the wake of that choice, Gaku realizes he can't play the style his father demands, but swears he'll defeat both Kei and Noboru with a game that's entirely his own. (Source: K MANGA)

titleRomaji: 7th
titleNative: セブンス
synopsis: In a world of swords and magic, where the Goddess is revered, Lyell Walt was fortunate enough to be born the first son and heir to an earldom. That is, until his parents disown him for losing pitifully in a fight with his younger sister, Ceres. Lyell had once been hailed as a prodigy—a wonder child—but the birth of his sister changed everything. After Ceres wounds him in their duel, an enigmatic old man swoops in to rescue Lyell and bestows upon him a necklace containing a jewel that has been blessed by the goddesses and passed down through the last seven generations of Walt leaders. As Lyell sets out, necklace in hand, will he be able to prove himself despite his humiliating loss to his sister? And moreover, will he be able to solve the mystery behind Ceres’s monstrous strength and the strange sway she seems to hold over his entire family? (Source: J-Novel Club)

The Voiceless Sacrifice of the Black Dragon
synopsis: The Kozuki family was granted the Black Dragon's blessing, allowing them to heal the sick and purify impurity with their voices alone. But Ayame's life shatters after her parents' death, leaving her at the mercy of her cruel aunt and uncle, who tortured her until she lost her voice. As their daughter, Mari, rises to become the new priestess, Ayame is offered as a sacrifice to the Black Dragon. "Why do I have to die like this? Please help me!" In response to her desperate plea, the Black Dragon appears as a striking man and takes her hand, whisking her away to his realm. Chosen to be the bride of the Black Dragon Saku, Ayame finds herself in the enchanting Black Dragon Manor, suspended between the heavens and the human world. But jealousy ignites in Mari, who vows to reclaim Saku and make Ayame suffer once more. (Source: Pocket Comics)

title: Mizu Mahou Gurai Shika Torie ga Nai kedo Gendai Chishiki ga Areba Juubun da yo ne?
titleRomaji: Mizu Mahou Gurai Shika Torie ga Nai kedo Gendai Chishiki ga Areba Juubun da yo ne?
titleNative: 水魔法ぐらいしか取り柄がないけど現代知識があれば充分だよね？
synopsis: Frim, a 5-year-old orphan living on the streets in the slum, remembers her past life as a Japanese woman. Her daily life is filled with violence and injustice, and she has no one on her side. All she has is water magic and modern knowledge. Even a roofed place to sleep is a luxury. But by improving her environment with ideas that don't yet exist in this world, and finding ways to use water magic for things other than drinking, Frim gradually makes a name for herself... (Source: ComicWalker, translated)

title: The Despised Dark Mage Lives Again

titleEnglish: The Despised Dark Mage Lives Again
titleNative: 嫌われ＜黒魔術師＞のやり直し〜勇者に裏切られ、両思いだった聖女と命を奪われた俺、過去に戻ってすべてを取り戻す〜
synonyms: The Hated Black Magician’s Redo ~Betrayed by the Hero, the Saint He Was in Love with and His Life Stolen, I Go Back to the past to Get It All Back~
synopsis: Moments before victory, dark mage Kai Austin is betrayed and loses everything. His death becomes a reset, sending him five years into the past—to the day of the class assignment ceremony—with all of his magic intact. Armed with max-level dark magic and every memory of the future, Kai refuses to let history repeat itself. This time, he will protect Colette, stop the coming disasters before they begin, and destroy those who once betrayed him. (Source: WEBTOON)

title: The Flowers of Evil
titleRomaji: Aku no Hana
titleNative: 惡の華
synopsis: The story opens as middle school student Takao Kasuga receives an F on a math test. But he doesn't even seem to notice because he's too engrossed in surreptitiously reading Beaudelaire's The Flowers of Evil. And the day goes downhill from there. In a moment of weakness, he finds and takes home the gym clothes belonging to sweet, pretty Nanako Saeki on whom he has a major crush. Unfortunately for Takao, there's a witness to the theft: Nakamura, who has a huge chip on her shoulder and a sadistic streak. As the saga unfolds, we see Takao struggling to decide whether to confess or cover up his misdeeds at the same time that he tries to win over the girl of his dreams, and avoid the blackmail attempts of Nakamura, his new ”BFF.” Smart, funny, and emotionally engaging, The Flowers of Evil introduces a character who's not a hero, but just an ordinary teenager in search of true love and real friendship. (Source: Kodansha USA) Note: Includes one extra chapter.
